description: List members of the community, with pagination. Optionally filter by a search term (`query`, matches name/username/email), by role (`roleIds`), order (`orderBy`), and reverse. Returns edges[].node (with role) plus pageInfo and totalCount. Bettermode GraphQL query: members.

limit.description: Max number of members to return (1..100, default 10).

offset.description: Number of members to skip (offset-based pagination).

query.description: Filter to members matching this search term (name/username/email).

roleIds.description: Filter to members holding any of these role ids.

name: bettermode_list_members
title: List members
